summary: Growth percentages in the emerging tables must round to the nearest integer on both sides of zero, so a shrinking category is reported at its true magnitude, exactly as a growing one is.
reason: Adding 0.5 before the int conversion rounded only positive values, because the conversion truncates toward zero, so every negative figure came out one point too close to zero. A reprint must keep math.Round rather than restore the add-half form. Guarded by TestGrowthRoundsHalfAwayFromZero.
validated_outcome: Before the fix, TestGrowthRoundsHalfAwayFromZero failed on all 7 negative cases (-24 want -25, -49 want -50, -32 want -33, -12 want -13) and passed its 5 zero and positive cases. Across every pair with recent 2-500 and prior 1-500, the fix changes 0 positive results and 123851 of 124251 negative ones.
